welcome.title: Hello, I'm Doo
welcome.body: Half a minute to show you this screen.
points: Each screen has its own tour
You can stop it whenever you like

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: A project holds the work of one customer or implementation.

servers.title: Servers
servers.body: The machines the environments are deployed on.
points: Create one at your cloud provider
Or register one you already run
The machine and its invoice are yours

org.title: Organisation
org.body: It sets the scope of everything you see.
points: You can have one organisation per customer

done.title: Done
done.body: Each screen has its own tour.
points: A project's detail, when you open it

add.title: Add a server
add.body: Two ways to register a machine.
points: Create it in your cloud account
Register an existing one with a command
The machine and its invoice are yours

list.title: Registered servers
points: A machine out of space or out of signal stands out here

card.title: A server at a glance
points: Open it for the full detail

overview.title: Server detail
overview.body: Data sent by the agent installed on the machine.

alerts.title: Server alerts
alerts.body: Incidents on this machine, not the whole fleet.

settings.title: Server settings
points: Public or private network: it sets the instances' domain and where their certificate comes from
Retire the server from the platform

storage.title: Storage
storage.body: What this machine's disk holds, project by project.
points: Database, files and the backups kept here
Backups already off the server are shown under Billing

updates.title: Updates
updates.body: What this server still has to take, and when.
points: What is pending and when it applies

create.title: New project
points: The server its environments will live on
The name, which is used in the domains

list.title: Your projects
list.body: The ones in the selected organisation.
points: Only the ones your role lets you see

navResources.title: Resources
navResources.body: The project's consumption, environment by environment.
points: Reference before adding load to the server

envs.title: Project environments
envs.body: Each environment is a separate Odoo installation, with its own database and domain.
points: Button to create a new one

addons.title: Addons
addons.body: Where this environment gets the code it loads.
points: What you add here, and its access

backups.title: Backups
backups.body: Copies of the environment and its database.
points: Destination: your server or your bucket

done.title: End of the tour
done.body: You now know the whole project.
